label.zh: 谜团揭晓：永久的磁力奇迹
label.en: Mystery revealed: a permanent Magnetic Miracle

note.zh: 研究项目完成后，该星球获得永久的“磁力奇迹”修正，并不再触发本事件。
note.en: After the project the planet keeps the Magnetic Miracle modifier permanently and no longer triggers these events.

colony_mod.18.evidence: events/colony_events_3.txt:880-898 set_carrier_flag magnetic_mystery_solved, add_modifier magnetic_research_boost days -1; 00_projects_3.txt:672-684.

notes.zh: 审阅注：磁力奇迹（16）与磁力破坏（17）是同一殖民地一周年检查的 50/50 互斥结果。每次发生都使帝国计数加一；计数达到3时，该次事件的选项才开启“调查磁场之谜”项目（colony_events_3.txt:789-818、847-876）。
notes.en: Review note: Magnetic Miracle (16) and Magnetic Disruption (17) are 50/50 alternatives of the same first-anniversary check. Each occurrence adds 1 to an empire counter; only when the counter is 3 does that event's option open the research project (colony_events_3.txt:789-818, 847-876).

scope.zh: 从编译器把六类“星球修正殖民地事件”合并成的一个故事中拆出：此处只含强力磁场事件（16、17、项目、18）。入口为隐藏分派器 colony_mod.161。
scope.en: Split out of the compiler's single story that merged six independent planet-modifier colony events: this story holds only the strong-magnetic-field events (16, 17, project, 18), entered through the hidden dispatcher colony_mod.161.

uncertain: check_variable value = 3 is read as 'counter equals 3' following the script comment; whether the engine treats it as >= 3 is not visible in script.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.
